verdict.rationale: Logseq's own docs show block references: typing `(())` references a block on any page, with hover previews, sidebar opening and custom display labels. The evidence does not document embedding or transclusion, or that referenced content stays in sync with its source. missing for 10: explicit block embed/transclusion documentation, evidence that references stay in sync with source edits, section-level transclusion, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can reference or transclude an individual block or section of one note inside another and have it stay in sync

citations.quote: Type `(())` to reference a block on any page.
Hover over ref to see a preview modal of it.
References can have custom display labels.
